{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-opw2ln",
      "toKey": "n-14v88js",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The directory establishes separate operating locations (Utilities gallery vs RHOB station). A command/observation at one location does not prove valve state or supply continuity at the other. The lack of a unified record creates ambiguity that can lead to misinterpretation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the directory had established valve positions and pressure availability at any time, ambiguity would be reduced.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is a structural limitation of the record system rather than an event-based failure.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that the separation caused confusion in practice during this incident. The gap is whether operational procedures require cross-location verification when boundaries are pending."}, {
      "fromKey": "n-14v88js",
      "toKey": "n-gc2yt8",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Separate operating locations mean that a condition observed at RHOB (air-low) does not automatically reflect the state of upstream equipment in the Utilities gallery. This separation contributes to uncertainty about where the interruption occurred.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the locations were integrated into a single operational view, ambiguity about interruption point would be reduced.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is consistent with normal plant topology but highlights record limitations.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that confusion occurred due to separation. The gap is whether procedures require explicit cross-location status checks during boundary preparation."}, {
      "fromKey": "n-gc2yt8",
      "toKey": "n-z74g2j",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Maintenance receives the work boundary only after release. Until then, Utilities retains responsibility for system state but RHOB observes receiving conditions without full context of upstream changes or valve states.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If maintenance received the boundary earlier (before release), RHOB would have clearer authority and context to act.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is a procedural rule, not an event.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that delayed acceptance caused harm. The gap is whether procedures require explicit communication of upstream status changes before maintenance release."}, {
      "fromKey": "n-1myxjth",
      "toKey": "n-14v88js",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Upstream pressure remained stable while downstream dropped. This suggests the interruption occurred in distribution or at RHOB, not upstream source. However, without valve state records, we cannot confirm whether a change from normal routing caused this.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If upstream pressure had dropped, the interruption would have been at source. The stable upstream suggests distribution or receiving-end issue.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is consistent with physics of supply systems.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that a routing change occurred. The gap is whether service-routing changes are documented and communicated."}, {
      "fromKey": "n-1cs3s92",
      "toKey": "n-z74g2j",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Desk entries do not log field operations or identify interruption point. This limits ability to determine whether maintenance release was premature or if upstream changes were communicated.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If desk entries logged field operations and interruption points, we could determine whether maintenance release was appropriate.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is a record limitation.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that lack of logging caused harm. The gap is whether procedures require detailed logging during boundary preparation."}, {
      "fromKey": "n-1rww984",
      "toKey": "n-z74g2j",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No documented confirmation of understanding regarding root cause assessment or response steps. This limits ability to determine whether Utilities and RHOB shared a common mental model during the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If documentation of understanding existed, we could verify whether both parties shared the same mental model.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is a record limitation.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that lack of confirmation caused harm. The gap is whether procedures require explicit communication and acknowledgment during boundary preparation."}, {
      "fromKey": "n-1lq9li6",
      "toKey": "n-z74g2j",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Area directory does not establish valve positions or pressure availability. This limits ability to determine whether a change in service routing occurred without documentation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If directory established valve positions and pressure availability, we could determine whether a routing change occurred.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is a record limitation.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that lack of information caused harm. The gap is whether procedures require explicit communication of upstream status changes before maintenance release."}, {
      "fromKey": "n-1ubp9xd",
      "toKey": "n-z74g2j",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "RHOB requested Utilities attendance at 10:00; work paused by 10:02. This suggests communication occurred but may have been delayed or incomplete.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If communication had been immediate and complete, work might have paused earlier or response could have been faster.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is consistent with normal operational delays.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that delay caused harm. The gap is whether procedures require explicit acknowledgment of upstream status changes."}, {
      "fromKey": "n-1hmiwux",
      "toKey": "n-z74g2j",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Crew held current qualifications but no evidence they received recent change briefing or saw specific configuration drawing. This limits ability to determine whether crew understood system changes.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If crew had received recent change briefing, they might have understood system changes better.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is a record limitation.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that lack of briefing caused harm. The gap is whether procedures require explicit communication of upstream status changes before maintenance release."}, {
      "fromKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "toKey": "n-z74g2j",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Maintenance acceptance signature was not yet signed at notification time. This suggests boundary preparation was incomplete when interruption occurred.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If maintenance acceptance signature had been signed, boundary would have been released and work could proceed.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is consistent with normal operational delays.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that incomplete release caused harm. The gap is whether procedures require explicit communication of upstream status changes before maintenance release."}, {
      "fromKey": "n-16kxawb",
      "toKey": "n-z74g2j",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No line opening was authorized at time of interruption. This suggests work was paused due to air-low indication rather than intentional isolation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If line opening had been authorized, work could have proceeded despite air-low indication.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is consistent with normal operational delays.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that lack of authorization caused harm. The gap is whether procedures require explicit communication of upstream status changes before maintenance release."}, {
      "fromKey": "n-1qw8yiu",
      "toKey": "n-z74g2j",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "RHOB reported air-low indication and requested Utilities attendance. This suggests communication occurred but may have been delayed or incomplete.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If communication had been immediate and complete, response could have been faster.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; this is consistent with normal operational delays.","evidenceGap":"No evidence that delay caused harm. The gap is whether procedures require explicit acknowledgment of upstream status changes."}
  ],"decision":{"summary":"The incident involved an instrument-air interruption during maintenance preparation at RHOB process area while Utilities team was preparing #1 slab caster compressor/dryer system for planned maintenance. Evidence supports separate operating locations, incomplete boundary release, and lack of documented valve states or pressure availability records.","evidenceUsed":["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1","da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1","fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1","eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1","7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],"unknowns":["Whether a service-routing change occurred without documentation.","Whether communication breakdown contributed to delayed response.","Whether crew received recent change briefing or saw specific configuration drawing."],"alternatives":["Unrecorded service-routing change created unique hazard scenario.","Communication breakdown between Utilities and RHOB may have contributed to delayed response.","Potential unrecorded valve state changes affected instrument-air supply."],"confidence":0.75},"evidenceRequests":[
    "request sourceId=eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078 to verify whether temporary instruction attachment field was blank at issue time and if any changes were documented",
    "request sourceId=b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1 to confirm directory limitations regarding valve positions and pressure availability"
  ]}
